title: the guard that watches the tree of the checks and the refusal that names its cause
intent: The wave repairs two defects of the evidence of the package of the waves 97 to 100, and both were found by the discriminator of that package (docs/PLAN.md section 16.96).  (1) **F43.** The falsifier of the claim of the wave 100 says that no check of `tests/checks/' reads the stat file of a process by itself, and the check that proves the claim reads it itself -- the exception was named in the comment of that check and in no other place -- while the sentinel of that assertion watched two named files and not the tree of the checks.  The wave extends the sentinel to the tree of the checks and to the tree of the support, and it names the exception in the falsifier and in the text of the claim.  (2) **F44.** The branch of the refusal of `yeah-perm--mutating-tools' swallowed the cause of the refusal: a deliberately broken `lib/yeah-result.el' was reported as "the registry of the tools is not loaded", and the person who reads that refusal cannot act on it, because the cause may be a syntax error in a module of the kernel.  The wave keeps the cause: the error of the load of the registry of the tools is kept in `lib/yeah-risk.el', and the refusal of `lib/yeah-perm.el' names it.  That promise is a new claim, `a-refusal-names-its-cause', with a check of its own and a control of its own.  **The numbering is refined.**  The section 16.96 sent the findings F43 and F44 to the wave 105, and the section 16.101 (2026-11-21) named this wave instead: the wave 105 carries the red line of the package (F54), and F43 and F44 wait for the wave 106.
objection: The wave touches the kernel, and its price is named.  (a) **The guard of F43 reads names and not the machine.**  A path that a file builds by pieces, so that the word `stat' is not in the code at all (`(concat "/proc/" pid "/st" "at")`), is not seen by the guard.  That is a boundary on purpose: a false accusation is worse than no accusation.  (b) **The exception of the falsifier is a hole in the promise.**  The check that proves the claim of the wave 100 reads the stat file of a process by itself, and the promise now says so in the text and in the falsifier instead of denying it.  (c) **The scope of the claim of the wave 100 did not list `tests/support/'** before the amendment, while the falsifier now reaches it; the parent extended the scope on 2026-11-21 and the reason is recorded in the section 16.103.  (d) **The check of F44 asks the rule in a child process.**  A module that is already loaded in this Emacs cannot be loaded again from the copy, and the answer of the child is the only answer that can be about the copy; only `lib/' is copied, because the copy of the whole tree would carry the seventy-four megabytes of the plugin of the orchestrator into every run of the gate.  (e) **The live route was not checked.**  Neither F43 nor F44 touches the wire, the loop of a run or the journal; the changes are local and are covered by the offline controls.  (f) **Two sources contradicted each other and the contradiction is not resolved silently.**  The bullet of the package of the waves 97 to 100 in `AGENTS.md' promised F43 and F44 to the wave 105 ("the wave 105 extends the sentinel", "the wave 105 keeps the cause"), while the section 16.101 named the wave 106; the promise in `AGENTS.md' is corrected and the contradiction is recorded in the section 16.103.
note: The wave is the repair of two defects of the evidence, and every part of it was measured.  (1) **The place of F43.**  `tests/checks/check-a-check-that-reads-a-gone-process-decides-and-does-not-crash.el' -- the sentinel of the assertion 8 walked two named files and now walks the tree of the checks and the tree of the support; the exception is named in the code of the check (`yeah-check--stat-exceptions') and in the falsifier of the claim, so the guard and the promise say one thing.  (2) **The place of F44.**  `lib/yeah-risk.el' -- the error of the load of the registry of the tools is kept (`yeah-risk--failure', `yeah-risk-failure'), and `lib/yeah-perm.el' -- the refusal of `yeah-perm--mutating-tools' names it (`yeah-perm--refusal-cause').  (3) **The wording of the refusal, measured.**  Before: `yeah-perm: the risks of the tools are not known: the registry of the tools is not loaded'.  After: `yeah-perm: the risks of the tools are not known: the registry of the tools is not loaded: end-of-file: End of file during parsing: <copy>/yeah-result.el'.  The cause is named with the file and with the error.  (4) **The check of the new claim.**  `tests/checks/check-a-refusal-names-its-cause.el' -- it copies `lib/' into a temporary directory, breaks `yeah-result.el' in the copy, asks the rule for the profile `plan' there in a child Emacs, and looks at the refusal; the temporary directory is deleted when the check is done and the tree of the repository is never written.  Measured by the parent on the tree of this wave: the honest tree is green (the code 0, 432 ms) and the control of the claim, taken out of `spec.json' and applied to a copy of the tree -- `sed -i 's|(error (setq yeah-risk--failure err))|(error nil)|' lib/yeah-risk.el' -- makes the check fail by its own assertion (the code 1): "the refusal does not name the cause: REFUSAL=yeah-perm: the risks of the tools are not known: the registry of the tools is not loaded".  The file of the control stays readable (the brackets balance).  (5) **The measurements of the writer of the wave.**  Twelve runs, all of them named in the report of the writer: the honest tree of F43 is green (the code 0) and its forgery (a check of `tests/checks/' that reads the stat file of a process by itself) is caught (the code 1) with the name of the file; the registered control of the claim of the wave 100 refuses with its own words ("the state of a process that is gone raised an error"); the honest tree of F44 gives eight rules of the profile and no refusal, the broken registry gives the refusal with the cause, and the stand that swallows the error again falls with its own refusal (the code 1); the unit test of the permission rule is 16/16, the check of the risk of a tool is 0, the check of the permissions of the service is 0, the byte-compilation of `lib/yeah-risk.el' and `lib/yeah-perm.el' is clean.  (6) **The amendment of the claim of the wave 100.**  The text and the falsifier are amended (the exception is named, and the tree of the support is added), the scope is extended by `tests/support', and the id, the requirements, the control, the kind, the phase, the owner and the register stay as they are: the promise changed, the measure of the promise did not.  (7) **The new claim.**  `a-refusal-names-its-cause' -- the scope is `lib/yeah-risk.el', `lib/yeah-perm.el' and the check of its own; the control is the mutation of the place where the cause is kept, and it was measured by the parent, so the string that lies in `spec.json' is the string that was measured.
